notes.title: Czech update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This update adds Czech language support to the game.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This is a small update to reduce how much the digging popups block your view.

notes.title: Patch for crash when closing
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a problem where the game would sometimes freeze until it crashed while shutting down.

Thank you to the player who helped us track this problem down :-)

notes.title: Small tech patch
notes.notes: Just a small patch to fix some short freezes found in the game.

notes.title: Patch for new mines
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a problem where new mines would still be the same.
Each new mine is now randomly generated.

notes.title: Patch for a crash
notes.notes: This is a small update to fix a crash that was reported. Thank you to the person who reported the problem!

notes.title: Small patch for performance and visual clarity
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have a small patch to address some technical issues:
[list]
[*] Improved performance, especially with large numbers of lifts.
[*] Increased the sharpness of some visuals, such as the in-game gems and ore.
[/list]

Happy digging :-)

notes.title: Patch for Chinese text
notes.notes: Fixes text not displaying correctly in Chinese on the store and on the splash screen.

notes.title: Crash fix patch
notes.notes: Fixes a crash when selling ore and gems. Apologies for this error.

notes.title: Small patch 2, 3, 2
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the opening screen may be stuck in English.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: A small patch to address some localised text not displaying correctly.

notes.title: Chinese update 中文版本來啦
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This update adds Chinese language support to Miner: Dig Deep!

Happy digging :-)

notes.title: Update notes for 2, 1, 11
notes.notes:
Fixed a relatively rare crash on the inventory screen.

Thanks to the person who reported this! :-)

notes.title: Update notes for 2, 1, 10
notes.notes:
This update includes:
[list]
[*]Balanced the drill's sound in the game, it's now quieter.
[*]Fixed the titles of some bags incorrectly showing as a small bag.
[/list]
Thank you to the players that let us know about these issues!

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
Improved the diagnostics for failures when the game is starting up.

This patch only has tech changes, no gameplay changes have been made.

notes.title: Update for choosing text size
notes.notes: The size of the text/UI can now be increased from the options screen.

notes.title: Patch for changing music volume
notes.notes: The volume of the music can now be changed from the options screen.

notes.title: Update notes for 2, 1, 6
notes.notes:
This update includes:
[list]
[*] Falling rocks are less dangerous: fixed a case of falling rocks hitting the miner when they shouldn't.
[*] Buying a new lamp now comes with a full tank of fuel.
[*] Added a drill fuel tank bar to the HUD.
[*] Added drill fuel, light fuel and bag storage indicator bars to the shop screen.
[*] Lower value gems (citrine and rhodolite) are now much quicker to dig.
[*] Falling ladders now land on top of lifts, rather than falling to the bottom.
[*] Reduced the "stickiness" of lift platforms. Pressing up or down away from a platform no longer teleports the miner back to the lift.
[*] Fixed the top of lifts being covered by dirt from a cave-in.
[*] Fixed parachutes not closing when the miner lands on a lift platform.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback on these issues!
Happy digging.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved the responsiveness of the miner's movement. The miner now comes to a stop much faster, avoiding the feeling of sliding.
[*] Fixed a crash when the game changed focus in some scenarios.
[/list]

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The game now displays a little reminder when you run out of light fuel.
[*] Teleporters are now covered by stone to prevent anything interfering with them.
[*] Fixed very minor instance of text missing from a popup.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch for some crashes
notes.notes:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur at the end of the game.
[*]Fixed a crash caused by spamming certain inputs.
[/list]

Thanks very much to the people that reported these!

notes.title: Crash fix patch
notes.notes: Fixed a crash when near the mine entrance in new mines.

notes.title: Patch for improved error logging
notes.notes: Version 2, 0, 5 has just one change that improves the descriptiveness of error logs.

notes.title: Patch for a text issue
notes.notes: Fixed lifts' remaining depth number not appearing on the HUD.

notes.title: Patch for a crash fix
notes.notes:
Version 2, 0, 3.

Fixed a crash when using lifts.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have a small patch to fix some small but urgent issues.
[list]
[*] Reduced the likelihood of cave-ins.
[*] Error logs are now kept on disk. Previously, old logs were lost.
[*] Improved performance and load times.
[/list]

Thanks for the feedback and for playing!

notes.title: Christmas update patch
notes.notes: A small patch to fix a crash that can occur in winter-themed mines.

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.notes:
It's that time of year again, Christmas has come to Miner: Dig Deep.

The winter update includes:
[list]
[*] Winter is here: lots of snow, Christmas trees, lights, and more!  (Temporary during the winter break.)
[*] Mines created near Christmas have ice platforms underground.
[*] Digging is now possible while on a grabhook.
[*] Improved gamepad controls for getting on and off lifts.
[*] Blueprints are no longer included in post-game mines.
[*] Added an option to toggle between displaying a window and fullscreen.
[/list]

Thank you for playing! We hope you enjoy the new update, and have a relaxing, safe and happy break!

Merry Christmas, everyone!

notes.title: Minor patch for some issues
notes.notes:
A small patch has just been released that fixes the following:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when loading some mines.
[*] Control changes can now be reset to their defaults by pressing the F5 key.  (In case a recovery is needed due to a bad control setup.)
[/list]

notes.title: The second patch
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have another patch with the following improvements:
[list]
[*] Falling boulders are a little more forgiving. When you're only a little bit too close, the boulder will push you aside.
[*] Screen shakes can now be reduced. Available in the options menu.
[*] Cave-ins are now shorter and less frequent.
[*] Fixed an issue with cave-ins going for too long in areas containing a large number of lifts.
[/list]

Thanks again to you all for giving us your feedback on these issues!

We hope you enjoy this new patch.

notes.title: First patch
notes.notes:
Hi all,
We've just released a minor patch to address the following:
[list]
[*]Lifts now dig under stacks of rocks.
[*]Fixed the UI being too small on some PCs.
[/list]

These are fixes for issues that have come from the community. Thanks so much to you all for taking the time to share your feedback, we're reading everything, and are very appreciative!
